personality: 6 Glass / Luxe DARK fused with 7 Dark-First Utility for data density
personality_one_liner: A high-end, cinematic campus utility that tracks attendance and schedules with tactical precision and visually striking glass surfaces.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing on dashboard cards to elevate the glassmorphism. Avoid cramped layouts. Padding inside cards is md or lg.

do's: Use on the bottom tab bar and sticky headers.
Apply to the primary Attendance Hero card sitting over the dark architectural background.
Apply to pinned filters (e.g., semester selection) when content scrolls behind.
Combine with a translucent tinted base (>=75% surface) underneath to guarantee text readability in dark mode.
dont's: Do not apply to every list row or dense form inputs.
Do not rely solely on blur for contrast; always pair with a dark tinted scrim layer.
Do not use transparent glass over solid colored backgrounds; it only works over imagery or gradients.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: IMS authentication with roll number, password, and captcha.

states.loading: Blurred glass overlay with a sleek, crimson-tinted spinner.
states.error: Bottom sheet or toast showing error with red accent (e.g., Invalid Captcha).

screens.layout: Full-screen dark architectural photo in the background with a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to 80% surfaceInverse). A centered glassmorphic card (surfaceSecondary at 60% opacity with strong blur) contains the form inputs and a solid brandPrimary CTA. The NSUT wordmark or an initial-based logo sits at the top.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Dashboard showing high-level attendance and quick actions.
screens.layout: Hero section featuring an abstract 3D crimson glass image background. Overlaid is a heavily blurred, large glass card displaying the overall attendance percentage (using a circular progress indicator in brandPrimary). Below the hero, use a 2-column grid or single-column stacked cards (solid surfaceSecondary) for 'Today's Schedule' and a quick action button for 'Vacant Classrooms'.

screens.name: Attendance

states.loading: Circular skeleton loaders in a stacked list.
states.empty: Use the 'empty_state' room image with 'No classes scheduled yet'.
states.error: Error card with a prominent retry button.

screens.layout: Sticky glass header for filtering (e.g., All, Theory, Practical). A vertical scroll list of surfaceSecondary cards. Each card contains the subject name, current attendance %, and a linear or circular progress bar using the success/warning/error colors based on the threshold.

screens.name: Vacant Classrooms
screens.purpose: Live, time-based view of empty classrooms.

states.empty: Empty room image with 'All classrooms are currently occupied.'
states.error: Error loading timetable data; retry CTA.

screens.layout: Segmented control at the top (glassmorphic) for selecting time slots. Below it, a multi-column grid of pill-shaped or small md-radius cards (surfaceTertiary) listing room numbers. Highlight currently vacant ones with a subtle brandTertiary tint or green success dot.

screens.name: Results

states.empty: Illustration/empty image indicating no results found.
states.error: Failed to scrape results; retry CTA.

screens.layout: Accordion-style or stacked cards (surfaceSecondary) for each semester. Tapping a card expands or opens a bottom sheet with detailed subject-wise grades and GPA.

screens.name: Trending (Coming Soon)

states.empty: Use the abstract crimson shape image with a 'Coming Soon' message.

screens.layout: A single full-screen centered empty state layout. Large illustration in the center, display font headline 'Trending Soon', and muted body text.

login_hero_bg.alt: Dark modern university building architecture at night.

home_hero_bg.alt: Abstract dark 3D glass shape in red/crimson.

empty_state.alt: Dark cinematic empty room for vacant classes or empty states.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette; do not use any default blue or indigo. The brand accent is deep crimson (#D32F2F).
Use Outfit for display headings and Geist for body text. Enforce a maximum font weight of 500.
Implement the gradient scrim pattern (Layer 0: expo-image, Layer 1: linear-gradient fade to dark, Layer 2: content) for the Login background and Home Hero card.
Use Phosphor icons consistently across all tabs and settings rows. Fill active tab icons, outline inactive ones.

Apply expo-blur (or expo-glass-effect on iOS) for sticky headers, the bottom tab bar, and the primary dashboard summary card. Ensure a translucent tint base (>= 75% surface) under the blur to maintain readability in dark mode.
For the IMS login, wrap the form inputs in a glass card sitting over the 'login_hero_bg' photo to create a premium cinematic feel.
For the 'Vacant Classrooms' screen, utilize segmented controls for time slots and use the 'success' color (#166534) for indicating currently available rooms.
The 'Trending' tab is a pure empty-state screen utilizing the 'home_hero_bg' abstract crimson shape to showcase a premium 'Coming Soon' message.
